title: UVM: Driver Response Path
constraints: Write `class mul_driver extends uvm_driver #(mul_item)`. Get the virtual interface from `uvm_config_db#(virtual mul_if)` with field name `"vif"`.
For each item: wait until `busy = 0`, then drive `a`, `b` and a **one-cycle** `req` pulse (synchronous to `clk`, nonblocking assignments). Wait for the `done` pulse and sample `result`.

Return a response: a new `mul_item` with `result` filled in, and with `set_id_info(req)` so it reaches the right sequence. Two sequences share the driver in parallel, and each calls `get_response()` after every item.
Drive `req` to 0 when idle. The UVM library is the Verilator-compatible chipsalliance/uvm-verilator (UVM 2017), and building it takes about a minute.
hints: `seq_item_port.item_done(rsp)` completes the item **and** sends `rsp` back (the same as `put_response(rsp)`).
Without `rsp.set_id_info(req)` the sequencer can't tell which sequence the response belongs to, so `get_response()` waits forever.

examples.check: one sequence: every request gets a response
